guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Unattributed or non-official evidence
Mixing publication date and reference period
GB, UK, England or local-area scope drift
Confusing tonnes, vehicle miles, counts, kWh or CO2e
Treating activity or stock as measured GHG
Mixing installed/licensed stock with new registrations/applications
Treating provisional data as final
Ignoring published revisions
Dropping methodological coverage limits
Mixing residence, territorial or footprint accounting
Assuming current period from lagged release
Mixing vehicle, fuel, sector or waste classifications
Comparing incompatible shares or rates
Ignoring excluded populations, fuels or activities
Mixing application, issue, redemption, surrender or report states
Overstating small-area or modelled precision
Inferring emissions reduction from adoption/activity alone
Inventing parcel-level measurement from aggregate data
Joining sources with incompatible boundaries
Publishing without deterministic review gate
